title: Preserve work descriptions on posted sales prepayment documents
summary: Posting sales prepayment invoices and credit memos now loads the order's Work Description before copying the header, so the posted prepayment documents keep it. Previously the text could be lost when Calc. Inv. Discount caused the header to be reloaded.
key_points: Work Description BLOB is loaded right before TransferFields when creating prepayment invoice and credit memo headers
Fixes missing work description after the sales header is reloaded during invoice discount redistribution
Four regression tests cover invoices and credit memos with automatic invoice discount calculation on and off
Fix propagated to nine posting codeunits and tests to four test codeunits across W1 and localized layers
